rationale: The workflow already implements key optimizations supported by the evidence: (1) Dependency caching via actions/cache@v4 for pip in all three jobs (aligns with P-LIT-GHA-CACHE and P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE evidence showing ~9% elapsed savings, but the workflow already has this). (2) Concurrency control with cancel-in-progress: true (aligns with P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE). The primary remaining candidate from evidence is P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing the matrix job's fail-fast: false to true), but its contraindications include 'Every matrix outcome is required' and 'Full failure diagnostics are required'. For a test matrix across Python versions 3.9–3.12, preserving all outcomes is likely intended to ensure compatibility coverage. No completed run history exists to support P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT or P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT. Other patterns (change filtering, build selection, etc.) are not applicable or lack prerequisite evidence for this repository. Therefore, no evidence-supported change that preserves intended coverage can be proposed.
